name: Talas
source:
A novice god. She was looking for a new job after her father passed away.

She has an easygoing personality and is easily influenced by those around her.

[Translated from [url=https://kawawa-nowaki.jimdosite.com/picture%E3%83%BBchar/]official website[/url]]
